name: CactusFactory
caption: A 3D model of a tall columnar cactus with dense white spines covering its surface. The cactus has a primary vertical stem with a shorter curved arm branching out from the lower-left side. The entire surface is covered in short, white, hair-like spines giving it a fuzzy appearance typical of a columnar saguaro-type cactus. The green body with white spine clusters is rendered against a plain white background.
